statement: Starting from $x_0=1$, compute one iteration of the fixed-point iteration $x_{n+1}=\cos x_n$.
solution: $x_1=\cos 1\approx0.5403$ (radians). This iteration converges to the unique fixed point of $x=\cos x$ (about $0.739$).
hints: This iteration converges to the fixed point of $x=\cos x$.
